fetchFundingRates.description: the whole venue answers and only perpetuals are kept

createOrders.description: batch with a rejected order in the middle, orders and errors are index-aligned

fetchMarkets.description: a spot market and the perp of the same base get distinct symbols
active needs an order book market that has opened, an rfq only market and one opening later are inactive, fees are read per market and fall back to the type default
types drop the unwanted kinds before parsing

fetchOHLCV.description: paginate asks the venue for whole windows of 1000 candles and applies the limit to the result

fetchTickers.description: the whole venue answers, the USDC collateral row and markets that are not loaded are dropped, sizes and the underlying price are read
a single symbol that is not loaded keeps its row

fetchTrades.description: paginate stops once the cursor runs out
a trade on an option that is not listed keeps its unified symbol

fetchOpenOrders.description: fetchOpenOrders - reduce-only flag is read from the flags array
fetchOpenOrders - stop order keeps its non-zero trigger price
take profit limit and RPI orders, RPI is reported as post only

fetchPositions.description: fetchPositions - non-empty liquidation price is exposed
fetchPositions - closed and flat positions are skipped

fetchPosition.description: fetchPosition - a closed position is still returned

fetchGreeks.description: Fetch option greeks for a symbol

fetchAllGreeks.description: the whole venue answers and only loaded options are kept, perpetuals, spot and the USDC collateral carry no option greeks

fetchWithdrawals.description: paginate continues past a page without withdrawals

fetchOptionChain.description: the chain keeps the options of the asked base, an option that is not loaded is rebuilt from its id
an option id with a one digit day is rebuilt into its unified symbol

fetchFundingRateHistory.description: rows run newest first and come back oldest first
paginate follows the next cursor back to since
paginate applies the limit to the oldest rows from since
